hero.name: Naveen Ragipindi
hero.description: I help finance and operations teams implement, configure, and optimise NetSuite across every module — SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, custom workflows, all financial modules, reporting, and integrations. Avalara Tax and multi-platform integrations are my extra implementation strength.

about.title: Finance-first ERP consulting. Precision included.
about.bio: I am Naveen Ragipindi, a NetSuite Functional Consultant and Administrator with 3+ years of experience — end-to-end ERP implementations, configuration, and post-go-live optimization. I design and build solutions that make finance, operations, and sales teams faster, more accurate, and audit-ready.
about.bio2: I configure NetSuite using forms, fields, custom records, custom lists, and saved searches. I build custom workflows, KPIs, reports, and dashboards that give teams real operational visibility.
about.bio3: Every engagement is built to stay maintainable long after go-live.

achievements: Day-to-day configuration and maintenance of NetSuite ERP to maximise workflow efficiency and meet business objectives.
Setting up new users, assigning roles, and managing permissions across the organisation.
Implemented and supported NetSuite ERP modules: Finance, Procurement, Inventory, Fixed Assets, Sales & Distribution.
Configured Chart of Accounts, Tax Rules, Approval Workflows, Custom Forms, Saved Searches, and Reports per business needs.
Performed data migration activities via CSV imports for Customers, Vendors, Items, and Opening Balances.
Ensured compliance with statutory requirements (GST, TDS, Tax Codes) by configuring tax rules and validating reports.
Supported NetSuite–Concur integration for automated expense data sync and NetSuite–Salesforce CRM integration.
Assisted finance teams in Month-End & Year-End Closing and reconciliations — GL, Trial Balance, and Intercompany reports.
Developed and implemented NetSuite customisations to meet enhancement and maintenance requirements.
Customised fields, page layouts, record types, reports, and dashboards for business users.
Maintained users, roles, security profiles, and workflow rules across environments.
Led design review sessions with IT and business leads to obtain sign-off and deployment support.
Participated in NetSuite–Shopify integration to sync product catalog, inventory levels, and order data.
Assisted in NetSuite–HubSpot integration for lead-to-customer lifecycle management.
Found functional solutions to address system issues and created detailed ERP implementation reports.
Provided training to business users and offered ongoing post-go-live support.
Carried out gap analysis between processes before and after NetSuite implementation.
Worked on Custom Records, Role and Permissions Management, Workflows, Forms, Segments, Fields, and Saved Searches.
Supported NetSuite–Marketo integration for automated marketing campaign data and lead scoring sync.
Performed Vendor, Customer, Bank, AP/AR, Balance Sheet, and Inter-Company Reconciliation activities.
Conducted Inter-Company Reconciliation across subsidiaries in NetSuite OneWorld environment.
